title: Taurine attenuates activation of hepatic stellate cells by inhibiting autophagy and inducing ferroptosis.
authors: Li, Sen; Ren, Qian-Jun; Xie, Can-Hao; Cui, Yang; Xu, Li-Tao; Wang, Yi-Dan; Li, Su; Liang, Xing-Qiu; Wen, Bin; Liang, Ming-Kun; Zhao, Xiao-Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究牛磺酸通过抑制自噬和诱导铁死亡影响肝星状细胞活化，属细胞生物学与肝纤维化机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver fibrosis is a compensatory response during the tissue repair process in chronic liver injury, and finally leads to liver cirrhosis or even hepatocellular carcinoma. The pathogenesis of hepatic fibrosis is associated with the progressive accumulation of activated hepatic stellate cells (HSCs), which can transdifferentiate into myofibroblasts to produce an excess of the extracellular matrix (ECM). Myofibroblasts are the main source of the excessive ECM responsible for hepatic fibrosis. Therefore, activated hepatic stellate cells (aHSCs), the principal ECM producing cells in the injured liver, are a promising therapeutic target for the treatment of hepatic fibrosis. AIM: To explore the effect of taurine on aHSC proliferation and the mechanisms involved. METHODS: Human HSCs (LX-2) were randomly divided into five groups: Normal control group, platelet-derived growth factor-BB (PDGF-BB) (20 ng/mL) treated group, and low, medium, and high dosage of taurine (10 mmol/L, 50 mmol/L, and 100 mmol/L, respectively) with PDGF-BB (20 ng/mL) treated group. Cell Counting Kit-8 method was performed to evaluate the effect of taurine on the viability of aHSCs. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay was used to estimate the effect of taurine on the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde, glutathione, and iron concentration. Transmission electron microscopy was applied to observe the effect of taurine on the autophagosomes and ferroptosis features in aHSCs. Quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction and Western blot analysis were performed to detect the effect of taurine on the expression of alpha-SMA, Collagen I, Fibronectin 1, LC3B, ATG5, Beclin 1, PTGS2, SLC7A11, and p62. RESULTS: Taurine promoted the death of aHSCs and reduced the deposition of the ECM. Treatment with taurine could alleviate autophagy in HSCs to inhibit their activation, by decreasing autophagosome formation, downregulating LC3B and Beclin 1 protein expression, and upregulating p62 protein expression. Meanwhile, treatment with taurine triggered ferroptosis and ferritinophagy to eliminate aHSCs characterized by iron overload, lipid ROS accumulation, glutathione depletion, and lipid peroxidation. Furthermore, bioinformatics analysis demonstrated that taurine had a direct targeting effect on nuclear receptor coactivator 4, exhibiting the best average binding affinity of -20.99 kcal/mol. CONCLUSION: Taurine exerts therapeutic effects on liver fibrosis via mechanisms that involve inhibition of autophagy and trigger of ferroptosis and ferritinophagy in HSCs to eliminate aHSCs.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化是慢性肝损伤组织修复过程中的代偿性反应，最终可导致肝硬化甚至肝细胞癌。肝纤维化的发病机制与活化肝星状细胞（HSCs）的逐渐积累相关，这些细胞可转分化为肌成纤维细胞，从而产生过量的细胞外基质（ECM）。肌成纤维细胞是导致肝纤维化的过量ECM的主要来源。因此，活化肝星状细胞（aHSCs）作为受损肝脏中主要的ECM产生细胞，是治疗肝纤维化的有前景的治疗靶点。目的：探讨牛磺酸对aHSC增殖的影响及其相关机制。方法：将人HSCs（LX-2）随机分为五组：正常对照组、血小板衍生生长因子-BB（PDGF-BB）（20 ng/mL）处理组，以及低、中、高剂量牛磺酸（分别为10 mmol/L、50 mmol/L和100 mmol/L）联合PDGF-BB（20 ng/mL）处理组。采用Cell Counting Kit-8法评估牛磺酸对aHSC活力的影响。采用酶联免疫吸附试验评估牛磺酸对活性氧（ROS）、丙二醛、谷胱甘肽和铁浓度水平的影响。采用透射电子显微镜观察牛磺酸对aHSC中自噬体和铁死亡特征的影响。采用实时定量聚合酶链反应和Western blot分析检测牛磺酸对alpha-SMA、Collagen I、Fibronectin 1、LC3B、ATG5、Beclin 1、PTGS2、SLC7A11和p62表达的影响。结果：牛磺酸促进aHSC死亡并减少ECM沉积。牛磺酸处理可通过减少自噬体形成、下调LC3B和Beclin 1蛋白表达以及上调p62蛋白表达来缓解HSC中的自噬，从而抑制其活化。同时，牛磺酸处理触发铁死亡和铁蛋白自噬以清除aHSC，其特征为铁过载、脂质ROS积累、谷胱甘肽耗竭和脂质过氧化。此外，生物信息学分析表明，牛磺酸对核受体共激活因子4具有直接靶向作用，表现出最佳平均结合亲和力为-20.99 kcal/mol。结论：牛磺酸通过涉及抑制HSC自噬并触发铁死亡和铁蛋白自噬以清除aHSC的机制，对肝纤维化发挥治疗作用。
